description: Electricity Infrastructure in Ghana is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Catherina Cader, Andrés Andrade. Contains georeferenced files (geopackages) with Ghana's electricity infrastructure. Includes: electricity grid network, nightlight imagery, and binary night-light mask derived from it depicting electrified from non-electrified areas in Ghana. All georeferenced files have the projected coordinate system EPSG:32630. Coverage: national (GH); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: GeoTIFF. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
